title: Russia kills elderly couple in their home

contentText: In Ukraine, a Russian drone attack in the coastal city of Odesa killed a married couple in their seventies when their home was struck early in the morning, with several apartment buildings damaged—one nearly split in two—while separate drone strikes in the frontline region of Kherson also left two dead, a 68-year-old man and a woman whose identity was still being confirmed, according to local officials, in a report by Catherine Viette.
